cards.name: IJP2Export
cards.summary: Settings interface of CorelDRAW's JPEG 2000 export filter: the object Document.ExportBitmap(..., cdrJP2 or cdrJPC) returns answers these properties, which pick a .jp2 file or a bare codestream (Subformat), the compression level, the progression order and how masked (transparent) areas are coded; Finish writes the file.
use_for: scripted JPEG 2000 export of a page or selection for an archive or a print / GIS workflow that asks for JP2
a raw JPEG 2000 codestream without the JP2 wrapper (export constant cdrJPC, or Subformat = jp2Codestream)
large raster previews where JPEG's block artefacts are not acceptable
avoid: web or social delivery: browsers barely open JPEG 2000; use the JPEG (IJPGExport) or WebP (IWEBPExport) filter
vector output: JP2 is raster; use ISVGExport or a PDF export
unattended runs that call ShowDialog: it is modal and hangs the script
cards.how: Not created directly. ActiveDocument.ExportBitmap(FileName, cdrJP2 (= 820), Range, ImageType, Width, Height, ResolutionX, ResolutionY, ...) returns an ICorelExportFilter whose run-time object is the JPEG 2000 filter (coclass JP2Export); cdrJPC (= 821, 'JPG2000 Codestream (Export only)') is the codestream variant of the same export. Set these properties on it through IDispatch, then call Finish.

key_members.name: Subformat
key_members.use: Jp2Subformat: jp2Standard (0) = .jp2 file with JP2 header boxes, jp2Codestream (1) = bare codestream

key_members.name: Compression
key_members.use: compression level (long); the scale is not in the harvest, read the default back before setting it

key_members.name: Progression
key_members.use: Jp2Progression order: jp2Quality, jp2ResolutionQuality, jp2ResolutionPosition, jp2Position, jp2Channels

key_members.name: HasMask
key_members.use: read-only: the exported image carries a transparency mask

key_members.name: OptimizeMaskedArea
key_members.use: code the masked-out (transparent) area more cheaply (unverified)

key_members.name: OptimizedCompression
key_members.use: compression level that goes with OptimizeMaskedArea (meaning unverified)

key_members.name: Finish
key_members.use: writes the JPEG 2000 file (JP2 or bare codestream) with the current settings

key_members.name: Reset
key_members.use: puts the filter's settings back to their defaults (unverified)

key_members.name: HasDialog
key_members.use: read-only: the filter has an options dialog

key_members.name: ShowDialog
key_members.use: opens the JPEG 2000 options dialog (modal); optional hWnd parent

gotchas: nothing is written until Finish is called: ExportBitmap / ExportEx only set the export up and hand back this filter object
the export constants are cdrJP2 (820, JP2 file) and cdrJPC (821, bare codestream), both export-only; cdrJPG2000Import (818) is the import filter and will not export
Compression and OptimizedCompression are bare longs with no harvested range: probe the values the dialog writes before scripting them (unverified)
spelled Subformat here but SubFormat on IJPGExport; late-bound name lookup is case-insensitive, so both spellings resolve (unverified)
ShowDialog opens the filter's modal options dialog and blocks the COM call until a person closes it: never call it in an unattended run

Python win32com: an early-bound (gencache / EnsureDispatch) result is wrapped as ICorelExportFilter and rejects the filter-specific names with AttributeError; set them late-bound, e.g. win32com.client.dynamic.Dispatch(f._oleobj_) (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim f As Object
Set f = ActiveDocument.ExportBitmap("C:\out\scan.jp2", cdrJP2, cdrCurrentPage, cdrRGBColorImage, 2400, 1800, 300, 300)
f.Subformat = 0     ' jp2Standard
f.Progression = 0   ' jp2Quality
f.Finish

review.changes: added the harvested codestream export constant cdrJPC (821) to summary, use_for, how and the constants gotcha (card implied cdrJP2 was the only export constant); Finish no longer names an unharvested '.j2c' extension

cards.name: JP2Export
cards.summary: Creatable COM class of CorelDRAW's JPEG 2000 export filter (FilterJP2Lib). It adds nothing of its own: its default interface IJP2Export carries Subformat, Compression, Progression and the mask options; this is the object that sits behind the filter returned by ExportBitmap(..., cdrJP2), and most likely by cdrJPC (unverified).
use_for: recognising the run-time JP2 filter object (CLSID / CastTo target) when inspecting an ExportBitmap result
scripted JPEG 2000 export, through the IJP2Export properties
avoid: creating it yourself to export: get it from ActiveDocument.ExportBitmap with cdrJP2
web delivery: JPEG 2000 is poorly supported in browsers; export JPEG or WebP
cards.how: COM coclass (cancreate) whose default interface is IJP2Export. In practice a script never creates it: ActiveDocument.ExportBitmap(path, cdrJP2, ...) returns an instance, and its members are set late-bound.

key_members.name: Subformat
key_members.use: on IJP2Export: .jp2 file (jp2Standard) or bare codestream (jp2Codestream)

key_members.name: Compression
key_members.use: on IJP2Export: compression level (long)

key_members.name: Progression
key_members.use: on IJP2Export: Jp2Progression order of the codestream

key_members.name: Finish
key_members.use: on IJP2Export: writes the file

key_members.name: ShowDialog
key_members.use: on IJP2Export: modal options dialog

gotchas: has no members of its own: every property is on its default interface IJP2Export, and scripts normally receive an instance from the export call instead of creating one
an instance made with CreateObject / CoCreateInstance is not tied to a document or file name, so it has nothing to export (unverified)
nothing is written until Finish is called: ExportBitmap / ExportEx only set the export up and hand back this filter object
cards.example:
Dim f As Object
Set f = ActiveDocument.ExportBitmap("C:\out\scan.jp2", cdrJP2, cdrCurrentPage, cdrRGBColorImage, 2400, 1800, 300, 300)
f.Finish

review.changes: summary: noted the harvested codestream constant cdrJPC as a second route to this filter (unverified)

cards.name: IJPGExport
cards.summary: Settings interface of CorelDRAW's JPEG export filter, answered by the object Document.ExportBitmap(..., cdrJPEG) returns: Compression (file size against quality), Smoothing, SubFormat (chroma subsampling), Progressive and Optimized encoding; Finish writes the .jpg. This is the With-block the macro recorder writes after an ExportBitmap call.
use_for: batch export of social posts, thumbnails and web images from CorelDRAW pages
client preview JPEGs at a fixed pixel size and quality
progressive JPEGs for web pages that load top-down blurry-to-sharp
avoid: artwork that needs a transparent background: JPEG has no alpha; use IPNGExport or IWEBPExport
flat logos, text and line art: JPEG rings around hard edges; use PNG or SVG
print masters: a lossy JPEG is a poor master; export PDF or TIFF
cards.how: Not created directly. ActiveDocument.ExportBitmap(FileName, cdrJPEG (= 774), Range, ImageType, Width, Height, ResolutionX, ResolutionY, AntiAliasingType, ...) returns an ICorelExportFilter whose run-time object is the JPEG filter (coclass JPGExport); set these properties late-bound, then call Finish.

key_members.name: Compression
key_members.use: compression amount (long): higher = smaller file, lower quality; the export dialog shows the inverse as Quality (unverified)

key_members.name: Smoothing
key_members.use: smoothing applied before encoding to hide block artefacts (long; scale not in the harvest, unverified)

key_members.name: SubFormat
key_members.use: chroma subsampling, the dialog's Sub format list (standard or optional); which long value means which is not in the harvest (unverified)

key_members.name: Progressive
key_members.use: write a progressive JPEG

key_members.name: Optimized
key_members.use: optimised Huffman tables: slightly smaller file, same pixels

key_members.name: Finish
key_members.use: writes the .jpg with the current settings

key_members.name: Reset
key_members.use: puts the JPEG settings back to their defaults (unverified)

key_members.name: HasDialog
key_members.use: read-only: the filter has an options dialog

key_members.name: ShowDialog
key_members.use: opens the JPEG export dialog (modal)

gotchas: nothing is written until Finish is called: ExportBitmap / ExportEx only set the export up and hand back this filter object
Compression is not 'quality': a high value means heavy compression and visible artefacts (unverified scale)
pixel size, resolution, colour mode and anti-aliasing are ExportBitmap arguments, not filter properties
a CMYK ImageType writes a CMYK JPEG that many web viewers show with wrong colours; use cdrRGBColorImage for screens
ShowDialog opens the filter's modal options dialog and blocks the COM call until a person closes it: never call it in an unattended run

Python win32com: an early-bound (gencache / EnsureDispatch) result is wrapped as ICorelExportFilter and rejects the filter-specific names with AttributeError; set them late-bound, e.g. win32com.client.dynamic.Dispatch(f._oleobj_) (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim f As Object
Set f = ActiveDocument.ExportBitmap("C:\out\post.jpg", cdrJPEG, cdrCurrentPage, cdrRGBColorImage, 1080, 1350, 72, 72, cdrNormalAntiAliasing)
f.Progressive = False
f.Optimized = True
f.SubFormat = 0
f.Compression = 10
f.Smoothing = 0
f.Finish

review.changes: key_members: removed figures not in the harvest ('100 - Compression' quality formula, '4:2:0' / '4:4:4' value mapping, 'Smoothing 0 = off'); kept the meanings, marked unverified

cards.name: IPNGExport
cards.summary: Settings interface of CorelDRAW's PNG export filter, answered by the object Document.ExportBitmap(..., cdrPNG) returns: interlacing, how transparency is written (none, one image colour, or the masked area) with its colour / palette index and mask inversion, plus read-only palette information for paletted output; Finish writes the .png.
use_for: transparent-background logos, stickers and icons for web, apps and video overlays
UI graphics, text cards and flat illustrations that need crisp edges
paletted PNGs for small files (ImageType cdrPalettedImage)
avoid: photographs for the web: PNG files get large; use IJPGExport or IWEBPExport
vector delivery that must scale: use ISVGExport
print: export PDF / TIFF in CMYK; PNG is an RGB screen format
cards.how: Not created directly. ActiveDocument.ExportBitmap(FileName, cdrPNG (= 802), Range, ImageType, Width, Height, ResolutionX, ResolutionY, AntiAliasingType, Dithered, Transparent, ...) returns an ICorelExportFilter whose run-time object is the PNG filter (coclass PNGExport); set these properties late-bound, then call Finish.

key_members.name: Transparency
key_members.use: PngTransparency: pngNone (0), pngImageColor (1) = one colour becomes transparent, pngMaskedArea (2) = the export's masked area becomes transparent

key_members.name: Color
key_members.use: the colour made transparent with pngImageColor (long colour value; encoding unverified)

key_members.name: ColorIndex
key_members.use: palette index of the transparent colour in paletted output

key_members.name: InvertMask
key_members.use: swap transparent and opaque areas of the mask

key_members.name: Interlaced
key_members.use: Adam7 interlaced PNG: shows progressively, slightly bigger file

key_members.name: Paletted
key_members.use: read-only: the output is a paletted PNG

key_members.name: NumColors
key_members.use: read-only: number of palette colours

key_members.name: PaletteColor
key_members.use: read-only, takes Index: one palette entry

key_members.name: MaskPresent
key_members.use: read-only: the export produced a mask to use for transparency

key_members.name: TransparentColors
key_members.use: variant list of colours treated as transparent (format unverified)

key_members.name: Finish
key_members.use: writes the .png with the current settings

key_members.name: ShowDialog
key_members.use: opens the PNG export dialog (modal)

gotchas: nothing is written until Finish is called: ExportBitmap / ExportEx only set the export up and hand back this filter object
a transparent background starts in the ExportBitmap call: pass Transparent:=True with an RGB ImageType so there is a mask; the Transparency property only chooses how it is written (unverified)
Paletted, NumColors and PaletteColor are read-only and only mean something when ImageType is cdrPalettedImage
ShowDialog opens the filter's modal options dialog and blocks the COM call until a person closes it: never call it in an unattended run

Python win32com: an early-bound (gencache / EnsureDispatch) result is wrapped as ICorelExportFilter and rejects the filter-specific names with AttributeError; set them late-bound, e.g. win32com.client.dynamic.Dispatch(f._oleobj_) (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim f As Object
Set f = ActiveDocument.ExportBitmap("C:\out\sticker.png", cdrPNG, cdrCurrentPage, cdrRGBColorImage, 1080, 1080, 72, 72, cdrNormalAntiAliasing, False, True)
f.Interlaced = False
f.InvertMask = False
f.Finish

review.changes: use_for and Paletted: removed the unharvested '8-bit' figure

cards.name: ISVGExport
cards.summary: Settings interface of CorelDRAW's SVG export filter, answered by the object Document.ExportEx(..., cdrSVG or cdrSVGZ) returns: SVG version and encoding, how styles are written, output size and units, coordinate precision, text as curves or with embedded / subset fonts, and whether placed bitmaps are embedded and in which format; Finish writes the file.
use_for: logos and icons for websites and apps
handing editable vector artwork to a developer or a web-animation build
compressed SVGZ export for the web (cdrSVGZ)
avoid: print delivery: export PDF
artwork built on lenses, mesh fills or bitmap effects: they have no clean SVG form and come out rasterised or approximated; export PNG instead (unverified)
cards.how: Not created directly. SVG is a vector filter, so use ActiveDocument.ExportEx(FileName, cdrSVG (= 1345) or cdrSVGZ (= 1347), Range, Options) which returns an ICorelExportFilter whose run-time object is the SVG filter (coclass SVGExport); set these properties late-bound, then call Finish.

key_members.name: Version
key_members.use: SvgVersion: svgVer10, svgVer11, svgVerBasic11, svgVerTiny11, svgVer12, svgVerTiny12; 1.1 is the safe choice for browsers

key_members.name: Styling
key_members.use: SvgStyling: svgInternalStyleSheet (<style> block), svgExternalCSS (separate .css), svgPresentationAttributes (fill / stroke as attributes, the most portable)

key_members.name: Encoding
key_members.use: SvgEncoding: svgUTF8 or svgUTF16

key_members.name: TextAsCurves
key_members.use: convert text to paths so the SVG needs no font

key_members.name: EmbedFont
key_members.use: embed the fonts used when text stays live

key_members.name: CharacterSubsetting
key_members.use: which glyphs get embedded: svgUsedOnly, svgUsedAndEnglish, svgUsedAndRoman, svgAll

key_members.name: GiveEmbededFontPriority
key_members.use: prefer the embedded font over an installed font of the same name (unverified)

key_members.name: Units
key_members.use: SvgUnits for Width / Height: svgInches, svgMillimeters, svgCentimeters, svgPixels, svgPercent

key_members.name: Width
key_members.use: output width in Units (double)

key_members.name: Height
key_members.use: output height in Units (double)

key_members.name: DrawingPrecision
key_members.use: SvgDrawingPrecision svg_1to1 .. svg_1to100000: coordinate scale, finer = bigger file (unverified)

key_members.name: UseDecimalPrecision
key_members.use: write decimal coordinates instead of scaled whole numbers (unverified)

key_members.name: EmbedImages
key_members.use: embed placed bitmaps as data inside the SVG instead of linking separate files

key_members.name: BmpExportType
key_members.use: SvgBmpExportType for placed bitmaps: svgJpg, svgGif, svgPng

key_members.name: FountainSteps
key_members.use: number of steps when a fountain fill has to be approximated (unverified)

key_members.name: EmbedJavaScript
key_members.use: include JavaScript in the SVG (what CorelDRAW writes is unverified)

key_members.name: Finish
key_members.use: writes the .svg / .svgz with the current settings

gotchas: nothing is written until Finish is called: ExportBitmap / ExportEx only set the export up and hand back this filter object
use ExportEx (or Export) for SVG; ExportBitmap is the raster route
the member is spelled GiveEmbededFontPriority (one 'd' in Embeded) exactly as harvested
with EmbedImages False the bitmaps are written as separate files next to the SVG; moving only the .svg breaks them (unverified)
svgExternalCSS writes a separate stylesheet the SVG depends on (unverified)
KeepPixelMeasurements is a hidden member: do not build on it
ShowDialog opens the filter's modal options dialog and blocks the COM call until a person closes it: never call it in an unattended run

Python win32com: an early-bound (gencache / EnsureDispatch) result is wrapped as ICorelExportFilter and rejects the filter-specific names with AttributeError; set them late-bound, e.g. win32com.client.dynamic.Dispatch(f._oleobj_) (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim f As Object
Set f = ActiveDocument.ExportEx("C:\out\logo.svg", cdrSVG, cdrSelection)
f.Version = 1        ' svgVer11
f.Styling = 2        ' svgPresentationAttributes
f.TextAsCurves = True
f.EmbedImages = True
f.Finish

review.changes: none

cards.name: IWEBPExport
cards.summary: Settings interface of CorelDRAW's WebP export filter, answered by the object Document.ExportBitmap(..., cdrWEBP) returns: lossy or lossless coding (Lossiness), a quality amount, a compression ratio and whether transparency is kept; Finish writes the .webp. How QualityAdvancedAmount and CompressionRatio interact is not documented in the harvest.
use_for: web and social images with smaller files than JPEG or PNG
transparent web graphics (WebP keeps alpha)
site hero images and thumbnails batch-exported from CorelDRAW pages
avoid: clients or older software that cannot open WebP: export JPEG or PNG
print: use PDF or TIFF
cards.how: Not created directly. ActiveDocument.ExportBitmap(FileName, cdrWEBP (= 825), Range, ImageType, Width, Height, ResolutionX, ResolutionY, AntiAliasingType, Dithered, Transparent, ...) returns an ICorelExportFilter whose run-time object is the WebP filter (coclass WEBPExport); set these properties late-bound, then call Finish.

key_members.name: Lossiness
key_members.use: switches lossy against lossless coding (which value means lossy is unverified; read the default back)

key_members.name: QualityAdvancedAmount
key_members.use: quality amount for lossy coding (double; scale not in the harvest, read the default back)

key_members.name: CompressionRatio
key_members.use: compression ratio / effort (double; meaning unverified)

key_members.name: Transparency

cards.name: IFitObjectsToPathDS
cards.summary: Data source behind CorelDRAW's Fit Objects to Path docker, which places the selected objects (or extra copies of them) along a selected path. It holds the docker's options (arrange-by and even-gap choices, rotation choice and centre, anchor corner, extra copies, spin and angle jitter, keep originals, group after) and the doFitObjectsToPath command. It is a UI binding, not a document object; several option meanings below are read from the member names and are unverified.
use_for: icons, dots or letters spaced evenly around a circle or along a curve (badges, seals, wreaths, clock faces)
border and frame ornaments repeated along a path
scattered confetti, leaves or stars along a curve with angle jitter
avoid: text along a path: use Text > Fit Text to Path (IVGText.FitToPath) instead
a repeat that must stay live and re-editable: a blend attached to the path keeps editing open (unverified)
unattended runs without the right selection: it needs the objects plus one path selected and reports problems through its own error box
cards.how: Not reachable from Application / Document properties. CorelDRAW's UI framework registers it as a data source for the docker; a script reaches it through Application.FrameWork.Application.DataContext.GetDataSource("FitObjectsToPathDS"), which returns an ICUIDataSourceProxy: read and write the options with GetProperty / SetProperty and run InvokeMethod("doFitObjectsToPath"). That name is not in the type library but is the one the docker binds to in Draw\UIConfig\DrawUI.xml (*Bind(DataSource=FitObjectsToPathDS;...)); whether the instance exists before the docker has been opened is unverified.

key_members.name: doFitObjectsToPath
key_members.use: runs the fit on the current selection with the current options

key_members.name: invalidSelection
key_members.use: read-only: true when the current selection cannot be fitted; the docker disables its apply button while it is true (DrawUI.xml)

key_members.name: selectionTargetType
key_members.use: read-only string describing the selected target (unverified)

key_members.name: selectionCount
key_members.use: read-only: count of selected objects, as a string

key_members.name: ArrangeByXmlItem
key_members.use: current 'arrange by' choice, a list-item id from ArrangeByXmlItems (unverified)

key_members.name: ArrangeByXmlItems
key_members.use: read-only XML list of the arrange-by choices

key_members.name: EvenGapsXmlItem
key_members.use: current spacing choice, a list-item id from EvenGapsXmlItems (unverified)

key_members.name: RotateChoiceXmlItem
key_members.use: how each object is turned along the path, an id from RotateChoiceXmlItems (unverified)

key_members.name: CenterOfRotationXmlItem
key_members.use: the point each object turns around, an id from CenterOfRotationXmlItems (unverified)

key_members.name: AnchorCornerActiveLocation
key_members.use: which anchor point of each object sits on the path (int; mapping unverified)

key_members.name: ExtraCopies
key_members.use: how many extra copies to place along the path

key_members.name: SpreadUniformlyOnSubpaths
key_members.use: spread the objects across every subpath of a compound path

key_members.name: clockwise
key_members.use: direction of the progressive rotation / spin; the docker enables it only when rotateFactorUsed or spinFactorUsed is true (DrawUI.xml), so it is not the direction of travel along the path

key_members.name: IgnoreSourceAngle
key_members.use: ignore the objects' current rotation when placing them (unverified)

key_members.name: rotateFactor
key_members.use: progressive rotation angle (double); its docker spinner is enabled only when rotateFactorUsed is true (unit unverified)

key_members.name: spinFactor
key_members.use: spin angle (double); its docker spinner is enabled only when spinFactorUsed is true (unit unverified)

key_members.name: angleJitter
key_members.use: random angle variation per object (double); its docker spinner is enabled only when jitterUsed is true (unit unverified)

key_members.name: KeepOriginals
key_members.use: leave the source objects in place and fit copies

key_members.name: GroupAfter
key_members.use: group the fitted objects when done

key_members.name: ErrorBoxDetails
key_members.use: text of the docker's error box after a failed fit

gotchas: a UI-binding interface: no Application or Document property returns it; reach it through the framework data context by its registered name FitObjectsToPathDS (from DrawUI.xml, not the type library)
it works on the current selection: select the objects and the path first and check invalidSelection before invoking
the *XmlItem properties take the id of a list choice, not an index: read the matching *XmlItems list first (unverified)
rotateFactor / spinFactor / angleJitter only apply when their *Used flags are true; those flags are read-only here and most likely follow the RotateChoiceXmlItem choice (unverified)
failures go to the docker's own error box (ErrorBoxCaption, ErrorBoxDetails, ErrorBoxOK); an unattended run can stall on it (unverified)
OnHelp opens the help viewer: never call it from a pipeline
DrawUI.xml also binds a PlaceByXmlItem / PlaceByXmlItems combo that this type library does not declare; it may still answer GetProperty by name (unverified)
cards.example:
Set ds = Application.FrameWork.Application.DataContext.GetDataSource("FitObjectsToPathDS")  ' name from DrawUI.xml
If Not ds.GetProperty("invalidSelection") Then
    ds.SetProperty "ExtraCopies", 11
    ds.SetProperty "GroupAfter", True
    ds.InvokeMethod "doFitObjectsToPath"
End If

review.changes: clockwise was described as direction of travel along the path, but DrawUI.xml enables it only with rotateFactorUsed / spinFactorUsed, so it is the rotation / spin direction; data-source name FitObjectsToPathDS confirmed from DrawUI.xml (how, gotcha, example no longer 'unverified'); invalidSelection and the *Used enable logic now cite DrawUI.xml; added the undeclared PlaceByXmlItem binding as a gotcha
